links.outcome: LLM panel selection accuracy versus hematopathologist-reviewed reference standard
links.effect: Direct panel selection accuracy was lower for ChatEHR (47% vs. 78%); history extraction accuracy was comparable (78% vs. 78%).
links.quote: Direct panel selection accuracy was lower for ChatEHR (47% vs. 78%), primarily due to errors in deterministic protocol execution and structured data interpretation.

links.outcome: Comparison of LLM against current CLS workflow on same cases
links.effect: ChatEHR matched CLS on history extraction (78% vs 78%) but was worse on panel selection (47% vs 78%); processing time 20.3 s vs 41 s.
links.quote: ChatEHR achieved comparable accuracy to CLS in extracting and categorizing prior hematologic diagnoses (78% vs. 78%).

unlisted_practices: Hybrid workflow pairing LLM clinical history extraction with rules-based laboratory algorithms for deterministic protocol execution

screen.reason: Evaluated an EHR-integrated LLM platform (ChatEHR) against manual review by clinical laboratory scientists for clinical history extraction and flow cytometry panel selection, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
